flagged.title: Power and Authority: Weber's Three Types
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly presents police physical restraint as an example of raw power contrasted with authority (F6), which would lose marks in an exam since state policing is an exercise of legitimate authority.

mark_affecting.quote: Imagine a police officer having to physically restrain someone on the street. That is an exercise of power. It relies on physical force and coercion to gain compliance. But contrast that with a judge... they are exercising authority.

flagged.title: Life Chances and Social Mobility
flagged.reason: The video states that Goldthorpe and Lockwood argued workers were becoming embourgeoisified (F14), attributing the exact thesis they famously tested and rejected to them, which would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: This was Goldthorpe and Lockwood's original 1960s theory. They basically argued that because these manual workers were getting richer, they were just absorbing middle-class values.
